UnitStatement: OperationLedgerPanel React component renders an Operation Review Ledger from model, analysisRun, editorIntents, proposal, and selectedReviewTarget inputs.
The panel builds its ledger via buildOperationReviewLedger and only renders records when the ledger has at least one record.
When no operations are queued, the panel states GUI and agent changes must remain proposed operations until explicit user acceptance.
Operation ledger records are local review evidence only; the panel does not apply operations and never creates professional acceptance.
buildOperationReviewLedger assembles records from editor intents plus an optional agent proposal and tallies decision counts by status.
The operation review ledger document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.operation_review_ledger with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

Ledger audit_posture asserts default user acceptance required, accepted records require explicit user signal, preview records do not apply operations, and rejected records do not mutate accepted state.

The ledger surfaces unresolved TBDs: durable operation audit persistence, final actor identity model, and durable applied-operation receipt persistence (session receipts only until the model-document persistence tranche).
editorIntentRecord builds a held audit record from a GUI editor operation intent sourced from the editor intent queue.
Editor intent validation_outcome is forced to status held_for_user_acceptance in the review ledger.
proposalRecord builds a held audit record from an agent proposal with record_source agent_proposal and actor_type agent.
Proposal record assumptions always include explicit user acceptance not recorded and operation application disabled in technical preview.
heldDecision returns status held_for_user_acceptance with explicit_user_acceptance false, acceptance_required true, and accepted_model_state_mutated false.
professionalBoundary asserts human_review_required true and all compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims false.
ledgerBoundary confirms review-only posture: requires explicit user acceptance, does not mutate accepted model state, no compliance or professional approval claim.
PcfPayloadSegment type fixes nominal_size to the literal TBD_SOURCE_REQUIRED, refusing to silently invent nominal pipe size.
PcfConversionWitness type records source quantity, target quantity in MM, conversion factor, and conversion status for auditable length conversions.
PcfExportPanel renders a Conservative PCF Export panel from model, mechanics result, and analysisRun, binding a canonical package hash.
PCF export is a conservative local review package only; unresolved target profile, nominal size, support, component, and translator-default behavior remain visible in diagnostics and loss reporting.
PCF export package document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.conservative_pcf_export_package (deliverable DEL-17-07, package PKG-17).
PCF export_profile ops.pcf.conservative_subset targets the pcf family with subset scope of invented straight pipe segments only.
PCF export profile enforces explicit units (no hidden defaults), project XYZ millimeter coordinates, and an authoritative sidecar ID map identity policy.
PCF export profile mandates a loss report for every package, blocks or loss-reports hidden translator defaults, and leaves supports unsupported or TBD until source-confirmed.
PCF package is not completeness, import-compatibility, solver-validation, code-compliance, release-readiness, or professional-reliance evidence.
pcfPayload converts node coordinates and pipe geometry to millimeters and emits conservative straight-pipe segments with TBD nominal size.
PCF payload declares bore, coordinate, bolt diameter, and bolt length units as MM and weight as KG with coordinate_basis project_xyz_millimeters.
PCF payload omits supports as omitted_entities and lists support restraint semantics and boundary-condition semantics as unsupported_entities.
PCF payload lists target profile version and each segment nominal size as tbd_entities.
conversionWitness records each length conversion to millimeters with decision_basis_refs DEC-018 and DEL-02-02.
expectedPcfConversionWitnessCount equals node count times three coordinate axes plus the number of present pipe-section outside-diameter and wall-thickness fields.
renderPcfText produces deterministic ASCII PCF text beginning with ISOGEN-FILES and STATUS FOR-REVIEW and terminated by END-ISOGEN.
PCF diagnostics raise a blocking PCF-COORDINATE-UNIT-TBD when the model length unit is not m or mm and thus not mapped to the millimeter coordinate policy.
PCF diagnostics raise a blocking PCF-NOMINAL-SIZE-TBD because preview pipe segments carry no source-owned nominal size required by the conservative profile.
PCF diagnostics warn PCF-SUPPORT-SEMANTICS-UNSUPPORTED that support and restraint semantics are not reliably preserved by the desktop PCF preview.
PCF diagnostics warn PCF-TARGET-PROFILE-TBD that the first supported PCF target profile/version remains TBD.
requiredLossCategoriesPresent verifies the loss report covers exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, and tbd categories.
convertLengthToMillimeters multiplies meters by 1000 (factor 1000) and leaves other units unchanged (factor 1), rounding to six decimals.
ProjectStorageAuditPanel renders a Project Storage Audit from model, storage capability, project summary, project index, and queued operations.
Model hash integrity line shows integrity_status, persisted vs recomputed values, and verification basis as a review-only integrity signal for human review.
Storage audit packets are local technical-preview evidence only; create/open/save operations do not accept model changes, copy external project files, or create professional reliance.
buildProjectStorageAuditPacket assembles a local project persistence audit from storage capability, project summary, project index, and pending operations.
Storage audit document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.local_project_persistence_audit with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.
Storage audit boundary asserts local_only_project_store true, repository_default_private_write false, accepted_model_state_mutated false, and no network, daemon, or telemetry requirement.
storageDiagnostics emits STORAGE-AUDIT-LOCAL-ONLY stating project storage is local technical-preview evidence and does not create professional acceptance.
Storage diagnostics emit STORAGE-FTS5-NOT-AVAILABLE info when the browser fallback storage is not FTS5 indexed.
RoundTripCategory type records a category, semantic_equality_status, checked_ref_count, and asserts no silent default, protected, or private payload expansion.
ProjectValidationPanel renders a Project Validation Preflight covering schema/version, migration, round-trip, and model/envelope hash evidence.
Validation preflight records version, migration, and round-trip review evidence for the local technical preview without applying queued operations or making professional reliance claims.
buildProjectValidationPacket assembles a project_validation_preflight packet with model-hash, envelope-hash, round-trip, store-migration, and model-document-migration evidence.
Version check status is supported_current_schema when model.schema_version equals 0.1.0, otherwise unsupported_schema_review_required.
Validation profile uses JSON Schema baseline 2020-12 and JCS-compatible canonicalization basis.
Project envelope hash scope is the persisted envelope payload excluding storage summary and hash carrier.
modelHashEvidenceStatus maps integrity status to verified_on_open, mismatch_review_required, recompute_unavailable, persisted-not-verified, computed-not-persisted, or service-unavailable.
buildRoundTripCategories declares semantic round-trip categories for model content, unit metadata, load payloads, rule-pack references, provenance, and reproducibility.
DEC-019 evidence: in-document semver is the version authority; migration runs in memory on open and persists on save with a ledger record.
modelDocumentMigrationEvidence builds DEC-019 migration evidence with version_authority in_document_schema_version_semver and asserts no destructive rewrite or down-migration.
buildStoreMigrationEvidence reports store schema migration framework/status and scopes migration to local store schema DDL only, with model document schema tracked separately per DEC-019.
unitMetadataPresent requires every project unit, pipe-section quantity, and material modulus to carry explicit unit metadata.
countUnitBearingRecords counts pipe-section, material modulus/expansion, and load magnitude quantities that carry a unit.
validationDiagnostics emits a blocking PROJECT-VALIDATION-UNSUPPORTED-SCHEMA when the schema version is not supported by the technical-preview preflight.
Canonical model hash is a local technical-preview review-reproducibility signal scoped to the model payload, not an acceptance, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance record.
Project-envelope hash is a review-reproducibility signal over the persisted envelope payload (storage summary and hash carrier excluded), not an acceptance or compliance record.
storeMigrationDiagnostic reports that store migrations applied on open are local store maintenance evidence only, not a model document migration or acceptance record.
ReportLintPanel renders a Report Content Lint summarizing scanned targets, findings, and blocking findings.
Lint output is deterministic technical-preview review evidence for public preview surfaces only; it is not legal clearance, redaction certification, or professional acceptance.
buildReportLintPacket scans public report surface targets for prohibited markers and claims and emits a deterministic lint run.
Report lint baseline is a deterministic public-surface heuristic linter; legal_clearance, security_sufficiency, and professional_approval are all false.
Lint run scans an explicit set of public surface roots and skips private surfaces unless explicitly authorized.
Lint finding order is path_line_column_code and synthetic markers must be invented, not protected examples.
Lint summary clean_scan_is_clearance is false: a clean scan is not clearance.
lintFindings matches each target text against protected-marker and prohibited-claim codes, emitting pending findings.
protectedMarkerCode flags synthetic PROTECTED_CONTENT, PRIVATE_DATA, and PROPRIETARY_SOURCE markers as BLOCKING IP/privacy boundary findings routed to human review.
prohibitedClaimCode flags text claiming software certifies, seals, approves, or is code-compliant for reliance as a BLOCKING PROHIBITED_PROFESSIONAL_CLAIM.
Public report surfaces must not claim certification, sealing, approval, authentication, or code compliance.
DEC-021 (A7): the Rust renderer crate composes, gates, and hashes the calculation report; this panel only requests a render and shows the canonical SHA-256 and gate state.
Save and print are refused while the renderer reports export_blocked; printed/PDF output is a derived view naming the canonical hash and is never hash-bound evidence.
RenderedReportPanel renders an FR-016 calculation report, exposing render, save canonical HTML, and print/PDF actions.
Report rendering is enabled only when both a mechanics result and an analysis run exist and no render is in progress.
When export is blocked the panel lists the blocking reasons instead of offering save; otherwise it offers a download of the canonical HTML named by the hash prefix.
The rendered report preview is shown in a sandboxed iframe; the derived print view is rendered to a hidden iframe that triggers print on load.
ReportPanel assembles a Report Packet from model, design knowledge, mechanics result, analysis run, comparison, editor intents, proposal, and persistence state.
Report panel uses invented or cleared preview data; private rule criteria and professional acceptance are not bundled.
reportDiagnostics aggregates model diagnostics, design-knowledge diagnostics, and mechanics-result diagnostics.
boundarySummary confirms human review required with no compliance, certification, sealing, or approval claim.
reportExportPacket builds an openpipestress.technical_preview.report_packet_export referencing many deliverables across the report and export tranches.
reportUnitSystemDisclosure binds the DEC-018 unit system reference and notes the report packet preserves entered and result units.
reportPersistenceEvidence assembles report_persistence_export_context with storage audit, validation preflight, and an export-readiness inventory.
Export readiness marks result envelope, stress-neutral, FEA handoff, native JSON, report packet, and handoff exports as pending until a mechanics run completes.
Report persistence boundary asserts local-only project store, repository_default_private_write false, accepted_model_state_mutated false, and no private/protected payload or release claim.
runAuditExport exports analysis-run audit fields: model state ref, run kind/status, result and hash counts, reproducibility input manifest refs, immutability policy, and professional boundary.
editorIntentBoundarySummary confirms review-only: requires user acceptance, no direct model mutation, does not mutate accepted state, no compliance or approval claim.
DEC-021 (A7): the frontend composes only references, disclosures, and display rows; the Rust renderer crate owns document composition, gating, and hashing.
Every renderer-input value is copied from session envelopes, computed locally with canonical-JSON/sha256 discipline, or an explicit visible TBD marker.
KNOWN_ANALYSIS_STATUSES enumerates MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, USER_RULE_CHECKED, USER_RULE_FAILED, and HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.

SECTION_KINDS lists the eight report section kinds: model input summary, load cases, results, warnings/assumptions/provenance, audit manifest, rule-pack references, limitations, and professional boundary notice.
PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY constant asserts human_review_required true and all compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims false.
DEC018_UNIT_SYSTEM_REF identifies the unit system unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display.
buildUnitDisplaySummary preserves entered units, sorts model and result units, and sets conversion_performed false (no report-time conversion).
buildRenderableReportInput assembles the renderer input document from session state, computing canonical SHA-256 hashes of the model and report sections.
Analysis status disclosures always append HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, requiring human professional review before any reliance on the report.
The report carries a technical-preview limitation: output over invented or user-local data is not validated engineering output and requires human review.
Report checksums use sha256 with rfc8785_jcs canonicalization, defaulting missing values to the literal TBD.
